name: ag
description: Initialize goals and evals, improve agents with measured fixes, and inspect results in the dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Init, Fix and Dashboard for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Use Init to inspect an agent, agree on behaviors and scoring, prepare reusable evals and establish a baseline. Use Fix to compare verified improvements and prepare a draft PR. Use Dashboard to inspect baselines, results and settings. Audit and Eval remain independently available. Intelligence requests require their own consent.
defaultPrompt: Use ag:init to inspect this agent, agree on goals and establish a baseline.
Use ag:fix to improve the saved goal and prepare verified delivery.
Use ag:dashboard to inspect baselines, results and settings.
